page.overview:
Who is Hamato Yoshi?

Hamato Yoshi was the greatest ninja and former master of before he was tracked down and murdered by the . His death occurred shortly before Splinter was mutated along with the . His further origins are shown and described in the season 4 episode "Tale of Master Yoshi".

Hamato Yoshi was a Japanese man with short straight black hair, dark brown eyes, light skin, and a muscular figure. He wore a tan sleeveless haori, a dark brown one-piece garment with lighter brown trim, and dark brown footwear.

Yoshi was kind, ensuring that fellow orphan Yukio Mashimi was also invited to be given a meal before accepting the 's offer and caring for even after moving away from Japan.

Yoshi was a preteen orphan in the early 1960s who begged for necessities in the streets of Tōkyō with his best friend, Mashimi. When Yoshi returned a 5 yen coin dropped by the Ancient One, they were taken in by him for their honesty, reared as his sons, and taught ninjutsu by him. The two boys grew up together in the same house learning the same arts. Unfortunately, they fell in love with the same girl, , another orphan taken in by the Ancient One and it became apparent that she returned Yoshi's feelings. Shen later spared a rat that had snuck into their house and kept him as a pet.
